[알림][오늘의영어]
오늘의 영어 공부 (2026-06-28)

[오늘의 단어]
- drive: 운전하다, 차로
- method: 방법
- over and over: 반복해서
- freeze up: 굳어지다, 태도가 얼어붙다
- strike up: 시작하다
- regain: 되찾다, 되돌아오다
- sibling: 형제자매
- conviction: 신념, 유죄 선고, 확신
- relentlessly: 끈질긴, 가차 없는
- C: 걱정 마세요.

[오늘의 문장]
- It's about an hour's drive from my home.
- I found a method that works for me.
- I used to freeze up whenever I met a foreigner.
- Once you hit 40, you start thinking a lot.
- In a foreign setting we had long conversations over drinks with our adult son.
- The only way forward was to tackle English head-on.
